type Point = tuple[int, int]
type = 3


def route(command, match):
    match command.split():
        case [action]:
            return action
        case [action, obj] if obj:
            return action, obj
        case Point(x=0, y=0):
            return "origin"
        case {"k": v}:
            return v
        case _:
            return match
